Product:{\"sku\":\"7100125157\"}.description({\"html\":true}):
Out of the highly successful Don Bradman simulation series comes Don Bradman JR, the hard-hitting arcade cricket game.
Step onto the pitch and feel the thrill of every shot. Don Bradman Cricket JR is fast, accessible cricket that's easy to learn and rewarding to master. Smash boundaries, outplay opponents and make every run count.

Pick up and play with intuitive controls. Every delivery is a contest: read the line, time the shot, find the gap. Got five minutes? Play a fast match. Got the afternoon? Play the full cricket experience.

And it carries the greatest name in cricket. Complete the Bradman Challenge Round and you'll unlock Sir Donald Bradman himself as the captain of the Australian side, along with the Bradman vs Water Tank Mini Game, that goes back to where the legend began: one stump, one golf ball and a water tank. Easy to pick up…impossible to put down.

PLAY YOUR WAY
• QUICK MATCH: Jump straight into the action. Pick your teams, set the match up your way and play.
• TOURNAMENTS: Compete across series, cups and knockouts. Take a side all the way to the trophy.
• CHALLENGES: Learn the game, test your skills. Challenges teach the basics, then push your abilities to the limit with increasingly difficult batting and bowling trials.
• COUCH MULTIPLAYER: Play 2 player split screen against your friends
• AI vs AI: Set the AI against itself and watch the match play out

REAL CRICKET ACTION
• MASTER: Master timing, power and shot placement. Pick the shot, pick the gap, clear the rope.
• CONTROL: Control line, length, pace and spin to outplay the batsman. Set the field, then beat the edge.
• ATTACK: Fast, exciting action from ball to ball. No waiting around, the next delivery is always coming.
• PRECISION: Your bat's movement is controlled by YOU. Your unique style determines the ball's trajectory. No two shots are ever truly the same!

AWESOME FEATURES
• Save and resume matches and tournaments at any time
• Fast matches or full cricket experiences
• 20 generic international teams
• Custom match options including limited overs or test match, and number of wickets, overs and days
• Separate difficulty options for both batting and bowling
